title: What Circular Material Passports Is
definition: Circular Material Passports: passports tracking materials forever.
description:
Circular Material Passports: passports tracking materials forever. This is Post-Scarcity Economy at its most ambitious — material IDs research, passport logistics engineering and scan infrastructure operations converging on a single goal: making passport hulls real.

Why it matters: Post-Scarcity Economy will decide recovery markets outcomes this century. Circular Material Passports is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working passport hulls, the larger material IDs vision stalls, and with it, the passport logistics systems that depend on it.

This database documents Circular Material Passports in full: what it is, the real research behind it today, the pieces it is built from, dated forecasts, runnable demo programs, and a teaching ladder from foundations to mastery. Every record carries a working program you can run.

title: Real Research Today: Circular Material Passports
definition: Today's documented research behind Circular Material Passports.
description:
The road to Circular Material Passports is already being paved. Time-banking networks (TimeBanks USA) trade hours as currency in hundreds of communities. The Doughnut Economics model (Kate Raworth, Amsterdam) reframes growth within planetary bounds.

Open-source hardware (Arduino, RISC-V) shows zero-marginal-cost production at scale. Together these programs form the material IDs foundation that Circular Material Passports will build on — the passport logistics results, the scan infrastructure methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as passport logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Readiness Estimator: Circular Material Passports
definition: Estimates Circular Material Passports readiness from component maturity.

Honest scoring is the point: a passport hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

definition: Simulates Circular Material Passports operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Circular Material Passports installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 45340 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where material IDs monitoring, passport logistics redundancy, or scan infrastructure maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Circular Material Passports Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Circular Material Passports: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Circular Material Passports — passports tracking materials forever.

Phase 1 — Prove (material IDs): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (passport logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (scan infrastructure): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (recovery markets): passport hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and industry-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
